verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's site claims an ecosystem of 3,900+ providers and 23,600+ modules for managing infrastructure across every cloud platform, and covers both cloud and on-premises resources. SaaS-style use cases are shown, such as managing GitHub repositories and team access, and DNS deployments. As a drop-in Terraform replacement, community users confirm it reuses the upstream provider ecosystem and that migration is easy. Missing for 10: first-party registry documentation naming the major cloud and SaaS providers, and independent hands-on confirmation of provider breadth beyond the marketing figures.
